definition:
sequenceDiagram
  participant A
  participant B
  A->>B: normal
  break oops
    A->>B: inside break
  end
intent: MINIMAL REPRODUCER, bisected out of mermaid-w3-06. The sequenceDiagram 'break' block alone - 5 lines, no box, no critical, no autonumber, no self-message - hangs the renderer for the full 30000ms and produces NO SVG at all (DOM snapshot svg:0). Bisection evidence: 'box rgb(...)' alone renders fine, 'critical/option' alone renders fine, 'break' alone hangs. Theme-independent (parent spec w3-06 hung in BOTH themes). Persisted separately from w3-06 so Stage 2 has a 5-line regression test for the hang rather than a 17-line spec with four confounded features.
